usedFor: Shopify is where products appear; Eclincher publishes your social posts. A “New Product” in Shopify can run “Create Post” in Eclincher so a launch is announced on your brand accounts.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Post” in Eclincher
bestTemplate.why: A new product is the clearest thing worth announcing, and “Create Post” publishes it to selected brand accounts with text and an optional scheduled time.

watchOut: A post that publishes straight away goes public, so review the text or use the optional scheduled time. “Abandoned Checkout” is polling and makes a poor post trigger.
